args.content:
name: Publish to npm

# Publishes the npm package using npm Trusted Publishing (OIDC). There is no
# token: the runner proves its identity to the registry directly, so nothing
# has to be stored in repo secrets, rotated, or typed from an authenticator.
#
# One-time setup on npmjs.com, under the package's Settings → Trusted Publisher:
#   Publisher:          GitHub Actions
#   Organization/user:  danmestas
#   Repository:         fslite
#   Workflow filename:  npm-publish.yml
#   Environment:        npm-publish
#
# After that, publishing a release is: push a vX.Y.Z tag (or run this workflow
# by hand for a re-run).

on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*"]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: npm-publish
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write # required for OIDC; without it npm falls back to token auth
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "24"
          registry-url: "https://registry.npmjs.org"

      # Trusted publishing needs npm 11.5.1+. Node 24 ships a new enough npm,
      # but pin it explicitly so a runner image change can't silently regress
      # us to token auth.
      - name: Ensure npm supports trusted publishing
        run: |
          npm install -g npm@latest
          npm --version

      # The tag is the source of truth for what gets released, so refuse to
      # publish a package whose version doesn't match it. Without this a
      # mistagged release would quietly publish the wrong version.
      - name: Check package version matches the tag
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
        run: |
          tag="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
          pkg="$(node -p "require('./npm/package.json').version")"
          echo "tag=$tag package.json=$pkg"
          if [ "$tag" != "$pkg" ]; then
            echo "::error::tag v$tag does not match npm/package.json version $pkg"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Publish
        working-directory: npm
        run: npm publish --access public
